verdict.rationale: MX documents Instant Account Verification, which returns account and routing numbers, and Tokenized Account Numbers for ACH money movement. Those are verified-credential building blocks the developer must pass to a processor themselves. The pack shows no documented processor partner integrations or processor-token exchange that hands linked-account credentials directly to third-party payment processors or platforms. The FDX data-sharing item covers sharing held data, not handing payment credentials to processors.
